query: What is the main objective of the IAM Solution Design Proposal?
ground_truth_answer: The main objective of the IAM Solution Design Proposal is to outline a comprehensive Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution for TechCorp, focusing on enhancing security, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring regulatory compliance.

query: What are the key components of the proposed IAM solution?
ground_truth_answer: The key components of the proposed IAM solution include Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), User Lifecycle Management, and Privileged Access Management (PAM).

query: What is the timeline for the TechCorp IAM implementation?
ground_truth_answer: The TechCorp IAM implementation is planned in three phases over a period of 12 months. Phase 1 (Months 1-3) focuses on core infrastructure setup. Phase 2 (Months 4-8) involves the rollout of SSO and MFA. Phase 3 (Months 9-12) will implement User Lifecycle Management and PAM.
